description: Add a new entry (note, document, or information piece) to a knowledge base.

content.description: Content or body of the entry

expiresAt.description: When the entry stops being true (ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-10-16T23:59:59+05:00). The bot ignores it afterwards and it is deleted within the hour. Null clears it.

folder.description: Folder to organize the entry: 'general', 'skills', 'contexts', 'documents', or 'faqs' (default: general)

id.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base

metadata.description: Optional metadata key-value pairs for the entry

source.description: Source type of the entry (default: manual)

name: neuron_create_kb_entry
title: Create Knowledge Base Entry
